intro: Usted and ustedes commands for giving directions, plus negative commands with tú and usted.
p.siga.consejo: It comes from «seguir» (yo sigo). With usted, the ending becomes -a: «siga».
p.gire.consejo: From «girar». Verbs in -ar end in -e with usted. The g sounds like h.
p.cruce.consejo: From «cruzar»: the z becomes c before e. In Spain it sounds «th».
p.tome.consejo: From «tomar»: with usted it ends in -e. With tú it would be «toma».
p.todo recto.consejo: It means without turning. You also hear «todo derecho». The initial r of «recto» is strong.
p.esquina.consejo: The qu sounds k: es-KI-na. You say «en la esquina» or «a la vuelta de la esquina».
p.semáforo.consejo: The accent is on the a: se-MÁ-fo-ro. It is an esdrújula word.
p.estación.consejo: It ends in -ción: the accent is on the ó. There are train, metro and bus stations.
p.plaza.consejo: In Spain the z sounds «th»: PLA-tha. Many towns have a «plaza mayor».
p.a la derecha.consejo: It is the opposite of «a la izquierda». It goes with «girar»: «gire a la derecha».
p.a la izquierda.consejo: In «izquierda», the z sounds «th» and the u is silent: ith-KYER-da.
p.hasta.consejo: The h is silent: AS-ta. «Hasta el semáforo» marks where the route ends.
p.al final de.consejo: You say «al final de la calle». The word «final» has no accent.
p.no se preocupe.consejo: It is a negative usted command, from «preocuparse». It is used to reassure someone.
b1.texto:
To give directions, the **usted** command uses the subjunctive form:

- **-ar → -e**: girar → **gire**, tomar → **tome**.
- **-er / -ir → -a**: seguir → **siga**, coger → **coja**.

For **ustedes**, add **-n**: **sigan**, **giren**.

The negative command always uses that same form: **no gire** (usted), **no gires** (tú). After **no**, you do not use **gira**.

With an irregular verb, start from **yo**: sigo → **siga**. And some letters change to keep the sound: cruzar → **cruce**.
b2.f0.texto: How do I get to the station?
b2.f1.texto: Go straight on as far as the traffic lights.
b2.f3.texto: Turn right and take the first street on the left.
b2.f6.texto: Cross the square and you will see the station at the end of the street.
b4.texto:
Compare the three forms of a command, affirmative and negative:

- **girar**: tú **gira** / **no gires** · usted **gire** / **no gire** · ustedes **giren** / **no giren**.
- **seguir**: tú **sigue** / **no sigas** · usted **siga** / **no siga** · ustedes **sigan** / **no sigan**.
- **cruzar**: tú **cruza** / **no cruces** · usted **cruce** / **no cruce** · ustedes **crucen** / **no crucen**.

Only the affirmative command with **tú** is different (**gira**, **sigue**, **cruza**). All the others use the **-e / -a** form.
b4.e1.texto: Do not cross the street here.
b4.e2.texto: Carry on along this street to the square.
b5.f0.texto: The pigeons fly over the square at dawn.
b5.f1.texto: Lucía walks slowly with the map in her hand.
b5.f2.texto: A narrow street runs down between coloured houses.
b5.f3.texto: The traffic light turns red with a little beep.
b5.f4.texto: The cars stop in front of the red light.
b5.f5.texto: At the end of the street the white tower of the station appears.
b5.f6.texto: A smell of warm bread comes out of a small bakery.
b5.f7.texto: Lucía turns the corner and feels the cool wind on her face.
b5.f8.texto: The station clocks show nine o'clock exactly.
b5.f9.texto: The long way ends with a smile of relief.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Well done: «gire» is the usted command of «girar».
b6.o1.refuerzo: «Gira» is for tú. With usted you say «gire».
b6.o2.refuerzo: «Giro» is yo: it is not a command.
b7.o0.refuerzo: That's it! The negative with tú ends in -es.
b7.o1.refuerzo: That states something; it is not a command.
b7.o2.refuerzo: «No gira» is about él, not tú.
b7.pregunta: How do you say «don't turn» with tú?
b8.frase: Siga todo recto hasta el semáforo
b8.traduccion: Go straight on as far as the traffic lights
b9.frase: No ____ la calle aquí, por favor.
b9.o0.refuerzo: Correct: the z of «cruzar» becomes c before e.
b9.o1.refuerzo: «Cruza» is affirmative tú; it is not used after «no».
b9.o2.refuerzo: «No cruces» is with tú. Here you are using usted.
b10.pregunta: Write, with usted: «Take the first street on the left».
b11.o0.refuerzo: «Tomas» is indicative with tú, not an ustedes command.
b11.o1.refuerzo: Well done! For ustedes you add -n: «tomen».
b11.o2.refuerzo: «Tomo» is yo and orders no one.
p.llego.consejo: From «llegar», to arrive. The «ll» sounds like a «y» in Spanish.
p.verá.consejo: From «ver», to see. The accent on the «á» marks the stress on RA.
p.señor.consejo: The ñ sounds like «ny». Use «señor» to address a man politely.
p.sigan.consejo: From «seguir». Here the g before a sounds hard, as in «gato».
p.palomas.consejo: Plural of «paloma». The stress is on LO.
p.vuelan.consejo: From «volar». The «ue» at the start sounds like «we».
p.casas.consejo: Plural of «casa». The c before a sounds like «k».
p.detienen.consejo: From «detener», to stop. The «ie» in the middle carries the stress.
p.ante.consejo: Means «in front of». Do not confuse it with «antes».
p.torre.consejo: The double rr in the middle is a strong rolled r.
p.relojes.consejo: Plural of «reloj». The j sounds like the h in «hot».
p.marcan.consejo: From «marcar»: a clock marks a time. The stress falls on MAR.
p.gires.consejo: From «girar». The g before i sounds like the h in «hot».
p.tomen.consejo: From «tomar», to take. Here it is a plural command.
